# Processing speed

**Speed on simple tasks.** Evidence: **established**. In the overall score: yes. Sky group: speed. Frameworks: CHC:Gs, NIH:pattern_comparison, NCPT:psychomotor_speed.

## Tasks

| Game | Paradigm | Loading | Origin | Reliability | Scoring | Metrics | Playable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Connect (`connect`) | Trail making A | 1 | classic | 1 | continuous | time_s | yes |
| Quick Draw (`quick_draw`) | Simple and choice reaction time | 1 | classic | 1 | hshs | median_rt_ms | yes |
| Symbol Code (`symbol_code`) | Digit-symbol substitution | 1 | classic | 1 | hshs | items_per_min | yes |

| Zigzag (`zigzag`) | Trail making B | 0.3 | classic | 1 | continuous | b_minus_a_s | yes |

## Scoring

- Main metric: Median RT, items per minute.
- Answers faster than 150 ms are anticipations and are dropped; a round that looks like random clicking gets trust 0 (`backend/scoring/quality.py`).
- Each answer moves the estimate with weight = loading x reliability x context weight x trust (`backend/scoring/loadings.py`).
- The skill is a Kalman-Elo estimate on a logit scale, shown as a percentage of a simulated population with its 80% range (`backend/scoring/kalman_elo.py`, `norms.py`).
- Timed games count an answer as a success when it is right within 50% of the deadline (`backend/scoring/hshs.py`).
- Raw trials are stored, so rounds can be re-scored later.

## Uncertainty

- A new estimate starts at sigma = 1.5 (an 80% range of about ±47 points) unless skill correlations give a narrower start (`registry/priors.yaml`).
- Its variance grows by 0.035 before each round and by 0.002 per day without practice.
- From a fresh start, about 7 rounds bring it within ±20 points.
- Practice can't narrow it below about ±19 points in the middle of the scale, because each round also adds noise (`backend/scoring/goals.py`).

## Biases and confounds

- device latency
- motor speed

## Evidence

Badge: **established**, strong construct, standard tasks, usable reliability.
